lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: Welcome, traveler. Our village has seen better days.

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: Monsters have overrun the lands surrounding our town. The fields, swamp, cave, and dungeon are all dangerous now.

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: We need someone brave to clear out these creatures. Will you help us?

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: You can use the portals in the town square to travel to different areas. Defeat all monsters in an area to unlock the boss portal!

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: Excellent! Start by clearing the slimes from the Eastern Fields. Return to me when you're done.

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: I can offer you gold, experience, and valuable equipment. The more dangerous the area, the better the rewards!

lines.speaker: Village Elder
lines.text: I understand. Come back if you change your mind. The town will always be safe for you.
